KnightLoader downloads from your own Usenet servers, plays a file while it arrives, splits a file across several sources and notifies you on Android, also with the app closed. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **Usenet from your own servers.** Add your provider under Accounts, Usenet servers, and an `.nzb` from Sonarr, Radarr, the upload button or the watched folder downloads straight from it over all connections. Fill servers are asked in turn, and articles none of them has go on to TorBox or Premiumize.me. Repair with par2 is not there yet.
- **Play while downloading.** Play in the download list, and a Play button in the Android app, open a video or song that is still arriving. KnightLoader fetches the part being played first, for torrents and direct downloads alike.
- **One file from several sources.** Switched on under Settings, Downloads, a file is split across a second debrid account and the spare mirrors the list keeps. A source joins only after it sends the same bytes at sample points.
- **Debrid accounts as a drive.** TorBox, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize.me and Debrid-Link appear as a read-only WebDAV share, so Plex or Jellyfin stream through rclone without downloading first. Off until you switch it on under Settings, Accounts.
- **Torrents on one network interface.** Pick an interface such as `wg0` under Settings, Torrents, and the built-in client sends nothing while it is down, like qBittorrent's kill switch.
- **Notifications on Android, also with the app closed.** Captchas, finished and failed downloads show up as notifications. This needs no Google services, so one app serves phones with and without them.
- **The extension takes over downloads.** Downloads that match your rules go to your instance with the site's cookies, so downloads behind a login work. The popup also lists the video and audio a page plays, HLS and DASH included.
- **Clipboard watch in the extension and in the background of the desktop app.** Copied links go to your instance, and only the links leave the device. If another device in your group already watches, KnightLoader names it and offers to switch it off there.

## ⚡ Improved

- The clipboard watches pick up FTP, SFTP and WebDAV links too.

## 🐛 Fixed

- Trackers stopped getting announces for the other torrents once one was removed. A torrent added again right after its removal now announces as new, and HTTP trackers hear when KnightLoader shuts down.
- A magnet removed while it waited for its file list stayed in the torrent client.
- A restarted download gets a new finish time, so the list and the history count from the second download.
- A long file name, from a rename, a rule or a crawljob, is cut between characters and keeps its extension.
- The desktop app keeps its instance id across restarts, so it is no longer listed twice.
- Fewer failed icon loads in the browser console.

## 🌐 Translations

- Every new text is in all 42 languages.
